title: Sense Runtime Cost Leaderboard by Device
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sense:device
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(kwh) as kwh by device_name _time
| eval est_cost=round(kwh*0.30,2)
| sort - est_cost
description: Uses Sense device energy data telemetry to monitor which appliances are costing the most to run each month in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for top contributors to the power bill, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Sense device energy data data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly device leaderboard by estimated cost.
grandmaExplanation: It frames which appliances are costing the most to run each month so you can spot top contributors to the power bill before it becomes annoying.
